title: Nuevo modelo open source: maya2-native
dek: Maya 2 Native brings streaming speech generation to the languages people use every day.
body:
Maya 2 Native brings streaming speech generation to the languages people use every day. Built by Maya Research, it generates 24 kHz speech in 12 languages, with 20 built-in voices and zero-shot voice cloning from 3–10 seconds of reference audio.

## Ficha rápida

- maya-research/maya2-native
- 2.5B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 6.3 GB (GPU 8 GB)
- licencia apache-2.0
- 134 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

Streaming text-to-speech for 11 Indian languages and English.

Listen · Get started · Explore voices · Benchmarks · Evaluation · Code

Maya 2 Native brings streaming speech generation to the languages people use every day. Built by Maya Research, it generates 24 kHz speech in 12 languages, with 20 built-in voices and zero-shot voice cloning from 3–10 seconds of reference audio. A voice can speak across languages: a Hindi reference can become Tamil speech.

Use it to give a voice agent its next turn, read a story in a familiar language, or build a multilingual interface you can host yourself. The release includes open weights and inference code, with a Python API, an OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint, and WebSocket streaming. Continuous batching and CUDA graphs support concurrent generation.
